criteria.gate_basis: unweighted judged counts (Wilson LB); HT rate reported alongside

t_lo_dial.basis: the zone decide_pair returned, over EVERY judged positive (the unstored ones as off_run); band share on the SCORED denominator (43,175), never the stored one, which moves with the calibration map
t_lo_dial.cliff: The 3% rule's answer sits inside a near-vertical segment of the calibration map: t_lo 0.0958 leaves 10,320 pairs in the band and 0.0959 leaves 4,945. Every row between them is one 1e-9 step of t_lo. T_hi is chosen on the 1e-4 grid (evaluate.expressible_cuts) because it is a precision gate the sealed split vetoes; t_lo is the budget dial, chosen by the 3% rule on dev alone, and is published at the rule's own answer with this sensitivity beside it.
t_lo_dial.note: c_trial 7.99 counts each pair once because BOTH endpoints are inside the closed trial cohort. In steady state a new listing resolves against the whole corpus and almost none of its candidates is another new listing, so the production shape is the blocking mean 15.03 (4.5% of listings already at the 60 cap, so a floor). Both columns are published; the qualitative reading is the same.
